Whether building projects from scratch or improving our solutions, we enjoy challenges that give us butterflies, which is why we work at a fast pace with respect, collaboration, and good humor. Along this journey, we also draw strength from diverse experiences and opinions to grow together, fail quickly, learn, and adjust the course to create solutions that deliver even better results.  #LI-Hybrid  Team Overview  We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Public Safety Relations Senior Manager for Brazil, who will oversee the operational engagement with public safety, law enforcement agencies and judicial authorities, serving as an expert partner to the Government Affairs, Security, Legal, Compliance, Online Safety, and Operations teams within the ride-hailing and delivery business.  This crucial position is dedicated to strengthening Didi's Public Safety partnerships, initiatives, and projects across Brazil, while employing technology-driven strategies to ensure strict adherence to data protection, privacy, and regulatory compliance standards.  Role Responsibilities   Implement and support operational processes for Public Safety engagement, ensuring alignment with business objectives related to ride hailing and delivery safety.  Serve as Didi´s Public Safety subject matter expert for public sector stakeholders, advocating for technology-based solutions within the ride-hailing and food delivery sectors.  Maintain and apply operational models and KPIs for law enforcement engagement, incorporating industry best practices to enhance service delivery.  Serve as a primary contact for sensitive investigations, government requests, and high-impact incidents, offering expert operational support to facilitate timely resolution.  Support the deployment and continuous improvement of law enforcement engagement platforms (e.g., LERT), emphasizing efficiency, traceability, and regulatory compliance.  Facilitate technology-enabled cooperation through frameworks, institutional agreements, and training programs that enhance interactions with law enforcement and judicial partners.  Collaborate with Legal and Compliance teams to assess and mitigate legal, regulatory, and reputational risks related to public safety and law enforcement interactions, particularly in the context of rides and deliveries.  Monitor and analyze public safety and law enforcement trends affecting the ride-hailing and food delivery sectors, focusing on privacy, data access, and public safety.  Work cross-functionally with global and regional teams, including Government Affairs, Legal, Security, Public Policy, Privacy, Online Safety, Engineering to support comprehensive public safety partnerships and initiatives.  Prepare and deliver operational reports and insights to local leadership, highlighting key developments and areas for improvement.  Uphold the highest standards of ethics, confidentiality, and data protection in all engagements with law enforcement and judicial authorities.    Role Qualifications   Bachelor’s degree in Law, Criminal Justice, Public Policy, Security, or a related field; advanced degree strongly preferred.  10+ years of experience in law enforcement, judicial systems or in senior-level law enforcement roles, or executive-level outreach roles within technology or multinational organizations.  Proven experience managing senior-level government and law enforcement relationships in complex regulatory environments.  Strong understanding of the Brazilian legal, regulatory, and law enforcement landscape, particularly as it applies to digital platforms and data governance.  Exceptional stakeholder management, negotiation, and influence skills.  Experience handling sensitive, high-risk, and high-visibility matters with sound judgment and discretion.  Fluency in English at an executive/corporate level; Spanish proficiency is a strong plus.  Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as required.  Executive presence and high-impact communication.  Data-driven decision-making and operational excellence.  Cross-functional communication.  High ethical standards and strong compliance mindset. Diversity is not a future vision or a wish for something we want someday; it is a non-negotiable value of who we are today. We embrace inclusion, plurality, and respect, and to achieve this, we rely on the governance of the Diversity Committee, which works alongside HR, our leadership, and identity groups—99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Colors, 99Womem, and 99Familys. This is our ongoing journey, with much more still to come.  We acknowledge and support that this position is open to all qualified applicants. Pré-requisitos  Preencha sua inscrição de forma mais completa possível, inclusive a parte do vídeo, pois é uma grande oportunidade de detalhar todas suas atribuições e nos auxiliar a compreender um pouco mais suas experiências. Somos o Sicredi, a primeira Instituição Financeira Cooperativa do Brasil  Muito prazer, nós somos o Sicredi.  Nossa trajetória começou há mais de 120 anos, como a primeira instituição financeira cooperativa do Brasil. Hoje, seguimos crescendo e nos transformando a cada dia, ao lado de mais de 50 mil pessoas colaboradoras. São elas que nos tornam a Melhor Empresa Para Trabalhar , ocupando novamente a primeira posição, segundo o Great Place To Work Brasil (GPTW).  Junto a mais de 9 milhões de associados, em todos os estados do país, acreditamos no poder da cooperação para construir uma sociedade mais próspera e gerar impacto positivo na vida das pessoas.  Um propósito que nos une e nos inspira, promovendo o desenvolvimento local e sustentável, a educação e a inclusão financeira.  Seguimos buscando talentos que queiram fazer parte da construção de um mundo melhor e queremos contar com você. #VemSerSicredi!   #J-18808-Ljbffr

Competência Comportamentais:   Atenção aos detalhes , organização e comprometimento com a precisão das informações.  Boa comunicação  e facilidade para o trabalho em equipe  e relacionamento interpessoal.  Proatividade  na resolução de problemas e disposição para aprendizado contínuo.    Benefícios:   Assistência médica  Assistência odontológica  Vale alimentação  Vale refeição    Localização  Rua Antonio Pinhata, 75, Distrito Industrial Maria Lúcia Biagi Americano, Sertãozinho - SP, Brasil,     #J-18808-Ljbffr

Our digital solutions simplify FX transactions  enable seamless access to US-based bank accounts  and provide innovative tools for managing international financial operations. We strongly believe that the best business results derive from teams that have a strong identification with a mission push themselves to the edge and love what they do. This role will focus on prospecting engaging and closing new clients  and its primary responsibility will be to identify potential customers demonstrate the value of our cross-border payment and banking solutions and convert prospects into long-term clients. You must be passionate about sales eager to learn and attentive to details. You must also be able to develop a deep understanding of Tensecs products and solutions and the industry to be able to match our offering with the right customer and suggest new product features to enable the long term success and growth of our customers and open new business opportunities for Tensec. Location: São Paulo  Positions in our hubs are hybrid and include core working days of Tuesday Wednesday and Thursday in the office. We provide flexible work options based on distance from our hubs. Tensec believes in the power of face-to-face personal connection. As a result we prioritize in-person candidates. Qualify inbound leads and generate outbound leads through cold calls emails and social media outreach. Negotiate terms manage objections and finalize agreements to achieve sales targets.   Ensure seamless onboarding of new clients coordinating with internal teams as needed.    Client Relationship Management  Own and drive the countrys P&L ensuring sustainable growth profitability and cost efficiency.   Identify opportunities for upselling or cross-selling additional services.    Collaboration and Reporting  Monitor progress towards meeting sales goals and report results to management.   Collaborate with the operations to onboard the customer on the Tensec platform in compliance with all local and global compliance requirements.   Collaborate with marketing product and customer success teams to align efforts and share insights.   Proactively suggest product improvements to the Product team to build the sales pipeline and enhance cross-sell opportunities.   Maintain accurate records of all sales activities and pipeline progress in the Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system.   Collaborate with other members of the sales team to develop strategies to achieve sales goals.   Stay up to date on market and industry trends competition and customer needs and provide feedback to other team members to support company growth and product development.     Required Qualifications:  Bachelors degree in business or a related field.  Experience in B2B sales or business development.  Familiarity with CRM tools like HubSpot Salesforce or similar platforms.  Knowledge of sales techniques and strategies and experience with outbound prospecting tools and techniques.  Excellent communication negotiation interpersonal and relationship-building abilities with the ability to build rapport and influence decision-makers.  Detail-oriented with a high level of accuracy.  Ability to work independently and as part of a team.  Customer-focused with a commitment to providing high-quality service.  You will stand out if:  Knowledge of the Brazilian financial ecosystem and regulations and a strong understanding of cross-border financial services FX transactions and/or digital banking solutions.  English and Spanish proficiency (both verbal and written).  Experience selling financial products and services.  In-office presence in São Paulo City Faria Lima neighborhood.   Personal Traits:  Goal-oriented self-motivated and able to work independently in a fast-paced startup environment.  Flexible and adaptable to change.  Exceptional problem-solving skills and a customer-centric mindset.  Excellent time management skills. Stock options: youll have a stake in our future success.  Medical dental VR VA plans and life insurance.  Gympass  Opportunity to work with an innovative globally-focused fintech team.  Professional growth in a high-impact role with plenty of autonomy and support.  Tensec is a developmental organization. We will invest and expect you to dedicate time to coach mentor and be mentored and to technical subjects and courses of use to your professional growth. CONHEÇA NOSSA HISTÓRIA   A Rede de Ensino APOGEU foi fundada no ano 2000, por três jovens empreendedores e ex-alunos do Instituto Tecnológico da Aeronáutica (ITA).  Ao longo do tempo, a instituição vem realizando, com êxito, o seu propósito: já são mais de 4.600 aprovações históricas em universidades públicas de todo o país.  E, em 2023, nasceu a APG GOV: que tem como missão transformar lives na Rede Pública Brasileira – a partir de um sonho audacioso: aplicar um modelo de gestão que apoiasse o diretor pedagógico e alavancar a inovação – junto a um compromisso profundo com o desenvolvimento individual e coletivo.  Estamos dedicados a proporcionar uma operação excepcional que prepara os alunos não apenas para sucesso acadêmico, mas também para uma vida de contribuição significativa para a sociedade.  Responsabilidades e atribuições  A Nutricionista é responsável pelo monitoramento técnico nutricional nas instituições de ensino, tendo como foco a oferta diária de alimentos saudáveis, adequados e seguros, do ponto de vista higiênico sanitário, resultando em menor desperdício e atendendo às necessidades nutricionais dos escolares durante o período letivo, de forma a contribuir para o crescimento e o desenvolvimento biopsicossocial, aprendizagem, rendimento escolar e formação de práticas alimentares saudáveis.  RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES    Utilizar ferramentas e mecanismos de monitoramento técnico nutricional na instituição de ensino, tendo como foco a oferta diária de alimentos saudáveis, adequados e seguros, do ponto de vista higiênico sanitário, resultando em menor desperdício e atendendo às necessidades nutricionais dos escolares durante o período letivo, de forma a contribuir para o crescimento e o desenvolvimento biopsicossocial, aprendizagem, rendimento escolar e formação de práticas alimentares saudáveis;  Observar as normativas federais do Programa Nacional de Alimentação Escolar - PNAE, as instruções normativas vigentes do Instituto Fundepar e do Conselho Federal de Nutricionista;  Atender ao Descrito no ANEXO I.I Alimentação Escolar do Edital de Chamamento Público SEED/PR Nº 17/2024.    Requisitos e qualificações  REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES    Formação acadêmica completa em Nutrição;  Inscrita e regularizada junto ao Conselho Regional de Nutricionistas da 8ª Região.    DIFERENCIAIS    Planejamento de Compras e Gestão Orçamentária  – Capacidade de calcular a demanda de alimentos e administrar o orçamento público ou escolar de forma eficiente;  Gestão de Estoque e Controle de Qualidade  – Experiência no controle de insumos, monitoramento de validade dos alimentos, armazenamento adequado e redução de desperdícios;  Habilidade de Comunicação  – Facilidade para interagir com a equipe da cozinha, gestores escolares, estudantes e responsáveis, garantindo alinhamento e efetividade na execução das ações nutricionais;  Compromisso com a Educação Alimentar  – Atuação ativa na conscientização da comunidade escolar sobre a importância de uma alimentação saudável e equilibrada;  Conhecimento básico em informática  – especialmente para preenchimento de relatórios e acompanhamento de sistemas de gestão.    Informações adicionais  INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS    Regime de contratação CLT;  Carga horária: 40 horas semanais;  Remuneração: R$ 3.500,00 + R$ 1.737,00 benefícios*   *com desconto legal em folha de pagamento       #J-18808-Ljbffr

Extensive experience with Email Service Providers (ESPs), including creating and reviewing complex segmentation queries. Excellent data and analytical skills, with the ability to interpret insights and provide actionable recommendations.  Proven track record in managing end-to-end CRM programs and email marketing processes.  Expertise in CRM principles, email marketing, and customer lifecycle management.  Demonstrated ability to drive measurable improvements in campaign effectiveness and KPIs.  Ability to define, implement, and promote best practices in CRM and email marketing.  Strong project management, communication, and analytical skills.  Experience collaborating with global stakeholders and managing relationships with email service providers.  Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint). Por isso, estamos em busca de talentos  para integrar nosso quadro de itubers (colaboradores do Itaú).  Conheça As Estruturas Que Compõem o Atacado   O Itaú BBA  é o maior Corporate & Investment Bank da América Latina. Atendemos investidores institucionais e empresas com faturamento anual acima de R$ 30 milhões. Pela complexidade dos negócios desses clientes, sabemos que nossa atuação deve ser customizada. Temos um portfólio de investimentos em ativos, assessoria em fusões e aquisições, oferta de ações, securitização, derivativos, operações estruturadas, cash management, financiamentos e garantias, entre outros. São soluções desenhadas por uma equipe de especialistas com base no perfil e necessidades de cada empresa.  Em Wealth Management and Services  somos responsáveis pela jornada de investimentos dos nossos clientes, olhando desde a gestão de recursos próprios ou de terceiros em Asset Management, Fund of Funds e Kinea, passando pela estruturação e evolução dos nossos produtos e serviços, até o relacionamento com nossos clientes, sejam eles pessoas físicas de alta renda no Private Bank e na assessoria de investimentos Íon, ou clientes institucionais.  A área de Global Markets & Treasury  é responsável pela conexão dos nossos clientes com o mercado, viabilizando o acesso deles aos produtos financeiros. Temos a missão de garantir uma oferta competitiva, inovadora e focada nas necessidades das empresas, cultivando o foco na excelência de atendimento e encantamento dos nossos clientes para gerar resultados.  O Que Estamos Buscando   Estamos buscando por pessoas que queiram se desenvolver e aprender constantemente, compartilhando, colaborando, inovando e entregando valor para todos os nossos clientes.  Como um futuro Ituber, é importante que você seja colaborativo (aqui a gente vai de turma!) para construir soluções e proporcionar melhoria contínua na jornada dos nossos produtos. Temos oportunidades em diversas áreas do banco de Atacado e precisamos do seu talento para contribuir com a transformação que buscamos.  Curtiu? Então, Vamos de turma?  Com quais benefícios vou poder contar?    Vale Transporte  Vale Refeição (Restaurantes) / Vale Alimentação (Supermercados)  Convênio médico e odontológico  Seguro de Vida  PLR (Mediante resultados do banco)  Previdência privada  Descontos exclusivos em nossos produtos financeiros  Licença maternidade estendida  Auxílio Creche / Babá (para papais e mamães)  Incentivo a estudos  Gym Pass (Mas se preferir temos Bio Ritmo em alguns polos)  Acesso aos Clubes Itaú (Guarapiranga / Itanhaém e São Sebastião)  + Algumas vantagens que você pode conhecer durante o processo

title: Marketing Manager
description:
Confira a vaga para Marketing Manager em região geográfica intermediária de são paulo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Overview Location:  Remote / Latin America (Preferred) Checker is the global liquidity network for stablecoins. We enable regulated financial institutions—such as banks, Payments Service Providers (PSPs), remittance providers, and FX brokers—to adopt stablecoins and scale their operations globally by plugging into our network. As we scale, we’re looking for an exceptional leader who understands the unique opportunities and challenges of bringing crypto payment solutions to this dynamic market. We are a global-first company. Our core team is based on the East Coast of the U.S., with colleagues in Europe and Asia. We come from trading, treasury, operations, and engineering backgrounds from Wall Street hedge funds, large crypto institutions, and blockchain technology startups. At Checker, our culture drives everything we do. We are true partners to our customers, meeting them where they are. We are at the forefront of fintech, so we approach every challenge with a mindset to “adapt and overcome.” You’ll thrive here if you excel in fast-paced environments and strive to make an impact. The Opportunity We are seeking a Marketing Manager, preferably based in LATAM, to localize and scale our go-to-market across Latin & South America. You’ll be Checker’s first dedicated marketer, collaborating with leadership and sales to grow Checker’s partnerships with scaled crypto apps, neobanks, fintechs, and regional banks. This is a full-stack role: Refine target account lists Shape the narrative for the region Run the mix—events, content, partner marketing, market-specific activations, product marketing and sales collateral, paid campaigns, and PR As we scale from hundreds to thousands of customers, we need someone who can create foundational sales collateral, implementation guides, and customer success stories that turn complex on-chain payment infrastructure into clear, concise value propositions. You’ll operate as an IC at first while building the foundation: Competitive research Localized messaging Playbooks Repeatable programs Over time, you’ll have the opportunity to hire specialized freelancers, agencies, and full-time staff.  What You’ll Do Regional GTM & planning  — Build the LATAM marketing plan tied to pipeline and revenue targets; define objectives, budgets, and quarterly calendars Target account strategy  — Partner with BD leadership to refine ICPs and named account lists; run ABM campaigns and outreach plays by segment (exchanges, neobanks, fintechs, banks) Partner & field marketing  — Design co-marketing with strategic partners (announcements, case studies, webinars, in-person events); equip BD with region-ready plays Localization & product marketing  — Translate and adapt messaging, proof points, one-pagers, pricing narratives, and demos for local buyers; maintain a regional message house Content for the region  — Produce market-specific explainers, regulatory primers, and customer stories that educate enterprise buyers on on-chain payments Events & activations  — Own LATAM event strategy (flagship conferences, roadshows, private roundtables); drive pre-/during-/post-event programs and measurable ROI Comms & PR  — Coordinate regional PR and earned moments with HQ comms and agencies Enablement  — Build regional sales decks, talk tracks, objection handling, and case studies Agency & vendor management  — Source and manage regional specialists (events, creative, PR, translators, etc.)  What We’re Looking For 7–10 years in B2B marketing, with meaningful experience in LATAM fintech, payments, or adjacent infrastructure Comfortable starting from first principles, creating clarity, and shipping programs solo before scaling Strong grasp of ABM and how marketing fuels enterprise deals; able to set KPIs and own outcomes Ability to translate technical concepts (stablecoins, on-chain payments, APIs, compliance) into clear value for executives and product leaders Full professional proficiency in Spanish; Portuguese strongly preferred Strong written skills for localization Practical fluency with CRM and marketing automation tools, analytics, and AI-driven content or translation workflows Based in LATAM (or ability to frequently travel to the region) Willing to travel: 25–40% for partners and events  What We Offer Competitive compensation Flexible remote work arrangement Travel to global team gatherings and industry events  We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

Avalia as necessidades dos clientes e sugere produtos, conforme diretriz por canal; responde a consultas mais complexas de clientes e tem autonomia para negociar preços e prazos de entrega dentro dos limites autorizados. Estabelece planos de vendas trimestrais, mensais ou semanais, prioriza e planeja suas próprias atividades para que as metas sejam atingidas. Participa do desenvolvimento dos planos de negócios de clientes a médio prazo e otimiza recursos para maximizar o crescimento da categoria. Trabalha com outras áreas para alcançar os resultados esperados. Desenvolve múltiplas alternativas de negociação e pode avaliá-las de forma aberta e justa. Identifica e descobre novas necessidades e variáveis dos clientes e da JDE e as usa para soluções dentro de limites planejados. Treina outros em como aplicar o processo de negociação e pode liderar uma negociação complexa. Controle e plano para atingimento de KPIs de execução (Loja Perfeita). Negocia ações de visibilidade com os clientes.  Qualificações Formação superior completa em Administração, Marketing, Economia ou áreas correlatas; Experiência na área comercial; Atuação em Trade Marketing; Desejável conhecimento de diferentes canais.  Informações adicionais Contamos com um programa de benefícios flexíveis em que você poderá personalizar seus benefícios de acordo com seu momento e estilo de vida. Assistência Médica; Assistência Odontológica; Previdência Privada; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Desconto de Produtos; Remuneração variável; Programa Grãos do Futuro (assistência e licença estendida para famílias gestantes e adotantes); Plano de Saúde Pet.  Nossa declaração de Diversidade Equidade & Inclusão Na JDE Peet's, nosso propósito é criar um futuro melhor, no qual servimos, refletimos e abraçamos todos em suas autenticidades. Acreditamos na promoção de uma organização mais diversa, equitativa e inclusiva, em que todos se sintam confortáveis para serem, verdadeiramente, quem são e possam despertar todo o seu potencial. Isto significa que não toleramos qualquer tipo de discriminação com base em raça ou etnia, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, religião, nacionalidade, idade, deficiência ou qualquer outra característica diversa e protegida por lei. Ao longo de todo o ciclo de vida dos associados, priorizamos DE&I no centro dos nossos processos de pessoas. Isso nos permite promover o respeito e eliminar qualquer preconceito ou ação discriminatória, garantindo uma experiência inclusiva no ambiente de trabalho. Não hesite em entrar em contato se precisar de qualquer suporte durante o processo de recrutamento. title: ENFERMEIRO AUDITOR SR
description:

autorizado  Verificar as opções de marcas sugeridas pelo cirurgião  Comparar a solicitação de OPME do cirurgião, com a relação enviada pelo hospital (casos em que o hospital não tenha negociação para entrega do material pelo GNDI – Grupo NotreDame Intermédica)  Sinalizar aos médicos auditores, do Núcleo Técnico de OPME (NTOPME), os casos que o hospital não tenha negociação para entrega do material pelo GNDI, para que a autorização de OPME seja realizada por carta  Analisar a solicitação de OPME, baseando-se nos padrões de liberação da GNDI  Realizar contato com médico solicitante para adequação de OPME e/ou marcas, seguindo padrões de liberação do GNDI, observando-se que a qualidade dos serviços sejam mantidas, e que haja otimização de custos  Descrever, no sistema de Gestão de OPME, os itens de materiais que deverão ser enviados para cotação, sinalizando as marcas sugeridas pelo cirurgião  Analisar as cotações devolvidas, checando se os itens cotados estão de acordo com os descritos, verificando se as marcas indicadas pelo cirurgião responderam a cotação, comparando-as com outras não sugeridas, mas que têm boa negociação com o GNDI  Liberar, no Sistema de gestão de OPME, materiais de acordo com a autonomia estabelecida  Realizar interface com áreas internas que forneçam subsídios às analise de OPME  Analisar a documentação pós-cirúrgica (RGO, Nota de Débito e imagem) e confrontar materiais utilizados x materiais autorizados previamente  Negociar OPME utilizados com prestador médico e hospital  Realizar as adequações dos materiais e as liberações para faturamento  Participar de reuniões, sugerindo e recebendo sugestões que facilitem e melhorem os processos da área  Participar de cursos e palestras que agreguem conhecimento e qualidade às suas atribuições  Executar outras atividades correlatas a critério do superior    Qualificações  Para o exercício do cargo de Enfermeiro Auditor é imprescindível que o ocupante do cargo tenha registro vigente no Conselho Regional de Enfermagem (COREN), além de estar com as obrigações financeiras plenamente quitadas no referido conselho.  O que oferecemos?   Vale Alimentação  Assistência Médica  Assistência Odontológica  Convênio com Farmácia  Auxílio Creche  Universidade Corporativa    Diversidade e Inclusão  Há 80 anos, oferecemos o melhor para cumprir a nossa missão de proporcionar saúde integrada de qualidade e acessível a gerações de brasileiros. Cuidamos com qualidade do bem-estar das pessoas de forma séria, comprometida e socialmente responsável, somando as melhores práticas para oferecer saúde acessível e de qualidade à população brasileira.  Temos o compromisso de promover a diversidade e a inclusão no local de trabalho. Nossos objetivos são pautados na construção de um ambiente livre de preconceitos, discriminação, assédio moral e sexual, desrespeito, injustiça ou condutas ofensivas. Além disso, buscamos criar um ambiente onde todos se sintam seguros para expressar quem realmente são, com igualdade e equidade de oportunidades.  Incentivamos a candidatura de todas as pessoas que se sintam alinhadas ao nosso compromisso de diversidade e à nossa missão de tornar saúde de qualidade acessível aos brasileiros.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

Habilidade de liderança por influência, com autoridade e capacidade de decisão.  Capacidade analítica e foco em resolução de problemas e gargalos.  Conhecimento básico de arquitetura de sistemas (front-end, back-end e banco de dados).  Conhecimento e prática no uso de ferramentas de IA aplicadas a processos de discovery e delivery.    Diferenciais    Experiência prévia em ambientes de startup ou scale-up.  Atuação anterior como gestora de produto dedicada. title: Business Development Analyst, Simplic (Hybrid)
description:

Business Development Analyst, Simplic (Hybrid)  Overview  Enova Overview Enova International (NYSE: ENVA) is a leading provider of online financial services for non-prime consumers and small businesses. With annual revenue of nearly $2 billion, we leverage advanced technology and analytics to serve millions of customers across the U.S. and Brazil. In Brazil, we operate as Simplic, offering 100% online personal loans with fast, flexible, and convenient access to credit. We combine the agility of a fast-growing startup with the stability of a large corporation, and we value smart, driven people who bring fresh, innovative ideas to the table.  About the Role  We’re looking for a Business Development Analyst who is curious, analytical, and action-oriented. You will identify market opportunities, shape product strategy, and translate insights into clear business cases and recommendations. The role combines market monitoring, product improvement, new product ideation, financial projections, and executive-ready storytelling to support decision-making and growth. In this role you will:   Monitoring market trends, competitive moves, and customer insights to identify opportunities and risks  Proposing improvements to existing products (e.g., pricing, features, funnels) and defining hypotheses, experiments, and KPIs  Scoping and proposing new products/partnerships, including go-to-market plans and pilot designs  Building managerial projections and scenario analyses (revenue, unit economics, volume) and maintaining concise performance dashboards  Preparing and delivering executive-ready presentations for leadership, with clear narratives, options, and recommendations  Build and cultivate relationships with cross-functional teams within the organization  Partnering cross-functionally with Product, Analytics, Marketing and Operations to align roadmaps, timelines, and impact tracking    We’re excited about you   Are a demonstrated self-starter and problem solver - You’ll be successful in this role if you can think critically and dig deeper to improve processes and campaign performance  Have strong analytical skills - Ability to analyze data, identify trends, and make actionable recommendations.  Are creative and think outside the box - The only constant in our industry is change. You love to brainstorm, generate new ideas, and bring creative, innovative solutions to the challenges our customers face every day.    Requirements   Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business Administration or related fields. Our team comes from a variety of backgrounds but are successful because of their ability to problem solve and think analytically  Demonstrate strong analytical thinking through excellent written and oral communication skills  Experience in Customer Service planning / optimization  Strong proficiency in both English and Portuguese (spoken and written).  Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel; Basic knowledge of SQL (or willingness to learn)  Our hybrid roles require in-office work Tuesday through Thursday, with remote flexibility on Mondays and Fridays. This schedule fosters collaboration, team connection, and strategic planning, enhancing communication and effectiveness to drive results.  Health, dental, and vision insurance including mental health benefits  401(k) matching plus a roth option (U.S. Based employees only)  PTO & paid holidays off  Sabbatical program (for eligible roles)  Summer hours (for eligible roles)  Paid parental leave  DEI groups (B.L.A.C.K. @ Enova, HOLA @ Enova, Women @ Enova, Pride @ Enova, South Asians @ Enova, APEX @ Enova, and Parents @ Enova)  Employee recognition and rewards program  Charitable matching and a paid volunteer day…Plus so much more!    About Enova  Enova International is a leading financial technology company that provides online financial services through our AI and machine learning-powered Colossusplatform. We serve non-prime consumers and businesses alike, while offering world-class technology and services to traditional banks—in order to create accessible credit for millions.  Being a values-driven organization is at the core of Enova’s success. We live our values by listening to our customers, challenging assumptions, thinking big, setting high expectations, and hiring and developing the best. Through our values and our commitment to making Enova an awesome place to work, we maintain an environment of inclusion and culture where our employees can thrive. You can learn more about Enova’s values and culture.  It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunity for all persons and not discriminate in employment decisions by placing the most qualified person in each job, without regard to any other classification protected by federal, state, or local law. California Applicants: Review our California Privacy Policy for Job Applicants. title: Hardware Troubleshooting Technician
description:
Confira a vaga para Hardware Troubleshooting Technician em são paulo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Why join us TRACTIAN is transforming the industrial world by empowering frontline maintenance workers to achieve more. We’ve fused cutting-edge hardware with innovative software into one powerful platform, disrupting legacy systems and delivering smarter, faster solutions for our clients. At TRACTIAN, you'll break boundaries, question convention, and collaborate with top talent to drive real change. As a part of our growth-stage startup, you’ll work alongside the founders, shaping the vision, products, and experiences that will define the future of industrial tech. Hardware at TRACTIAN The Hardware team is responsible for designing and improving our IoT devices, dealing with every step of the development process, ranging from PCB design, firmware programming, case design, validations and certifications, always aiming to build trustworthy products that can be produced at a mass scale.  What you\'ll do As a Hardware Troubleshooting Technician, you will play a key role in analyzing, diagnosing, and resolving failures in our devices, ensuring the reliability and quality of our solutions. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify root causes, document findings, and contribute to continuous improvements in processes and products. Your hands-on expertise with electronics, mechanics, and measurement tools will be essential to deliver effective outcomes.  Responsibilities Troubleshoot and diagnose: Perform in-depth analyses of electronic and mechanical devices, identifying failures following detection standards. Acceptance testing: Execute acceptance tests on electronic and mechanical devices. Documentation: Record written and photographic evidence, document occurrences in specialized software, and maintain detailed reports. Collaboration: Work closely with Logistics, Quality, R&D, and Operations teams to understand failures, propose solutions, and support root cause investigations. Inventory & lab management: Organize and maintain the physical and digital inventory of returned devices and those awaiting disposal, while ensuring the lab remains clean, organized, and fully operational. Continuous improvement: Propose and implement improvements to optimize processes and team routines. Technical expertise: Operate instruments such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, logic analyzers, microscopes, and other diagnostic tools. Communication: Actively participate in team and department meetings, presenting results and aligning actions with leadership.  Requirements Completed Technical Degree in Electronics. Proven professional experience in electronics troubleshooting, repair, or related areas. Enrollment in a Bachelor\u2019s degree program in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field. Knowledge of electronic circuits, components, and schematic reading. Understanding of mechanical manufacturing processes and basic concepts of hardware and firmware. Ability to interpret electronic technical documents (datasheets, schematics, PCB Gerbers) and mechanical documents (2D technical drawings and work instructions). Hands-on experience with measurement and diagnostic instruments (oscilloscopes, multimeters, logic analyzers, microscopes, etc.). Intermediate English fluency. Live or have availability to move to Sao Paulo.  Bonus Points Experience with scripting languages such as Python. Basic knowledge of programming languages such as C. Experience with other low-level programming languages. Fluency in English proficiency.  Compensation: Competitive salary and stock options Optional fully funded English / Spanish courses 30 days of paid annual leave Education and courses stipend Employee Giving Earn a trip anywhere in the world every 4 years Up to R$1.000/mo for meals and remote work allowance Health plan with national coverage and without coparticipation Dental Insurance: we help you with dental treatment for a better quality of life. Gympass and Sports Incentive: R$300/mo extra if you practice activities    #J-18808-Ljbffr

Overview Hardware Troubleshooting Technician  role at TRACTIAN  Join to apply for the Hardware Troubleshooting Technician role at TRACTIAN. Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features. Why join us TRACTIAN is transforming the industrial world by empowering frontline maintenance workers to achieve more. We’ve fused cutting-edge hardware with innovative software into one powerful platform, disrupting legacy systems and delivering smarter, faster solutions for our clients. At TRACTIAN, you\'ll break boundaries, question convention, and collaborate with top talent to drive real change. As a part of our growth-stage startup, you’ll work alongside the founders, shaping the vision, products, and experiences that will define the future of industrial tech. The Hardware team The Hardware team is responsible for designing and improving our IoT devices, dealing with every step of the development process, ranging from PCB design, firmware programming, case design, validations and certifications, always aiming to build trustworthy products that can be produced at a mass scale. What You'll Do As a Hardware Troubleshooting Technician, you will play a key role in analyzing, diagnosing, and resolving failures in our devices, ensuring the reliability and quality of our solutions. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify root causes, document findings, and contribute to continuous improvements in processes and products. Your hands-on expertise with electronics, mechanics, and measurement tools will be essential to deliver effective outcomes. Responsibilities Troubleshoot and diagnose: Perform in-depth analyses of electronic and mechanical devices, identifying failures following detection standards. Acceptance testing: Execute acceptance tests on electronic and mechanical devices. Documentation: Record written and photographic evidence, document occurrences in specialized software, and maintain detailed reports. Collaboration: Work closely with Logistics, Quality, R&D, and Operations teams to understand failures, propose solutions, and support root cause investigations. Inventory & lab management: Organize and maintain the physical and digital inventory of returned devices and those awaiting disposal, while ensuring the lab remains clean, organized, and fully operational. Continuous improvement: Propose and implement improvements to optimize processes and team routines. Technical expertise: Operate instruments such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, logic analyzers, microscopes, and other diagnostic tools. Communication: Actively participate in team and department meetings, presenting results and aligning actions with leadership.  Requirements Completed Technical Degree in Electronics. Proven professional experience in electronics troubleshooting, repair, or related areas. Enrollment in a Bachelor\'s degree program in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field. Knowledge of electronic circuits, components, and schematic reading. Understanding of mechanical manufacturing processes and basic concepts of hardware and firmware. Ability to interpret electronic technical documents (datasheets, schematics, PCB Gerbers) and mechanical documents (2D technical drawings and work instructions). Hands-on experience with measurement and diagnostic instruments (oscilloscopes, multimeters, logic analyzers, microscopes, etc.). Intermediate English fluency. Live or have availability to move to Sao Paulo.  Bonus Points Experience with scripting languages such as Python. Basic knowledge of programming languages such as C. Experience with other low-level programming languages. Fluency in English proficiency. title: CAE Engineer
description:
Nova oportunidade para CAE Engineer em são paulo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Why join us TRACTIAN is transforming the industrial world by empowering frontline maintenance workers to achieve more. We’ve fused cutting-edge hardware with innovative software into one powerful platform, disrupting legacy systems and delivering smarter, faster solutions for our clients. At TRACTIAN, you'll break boundaries, question convention, and collaborate with top talent to drive real change. As a part of our growth-stage startup, you’ll work alongside the founders, shaping the vision, products, and experiences that will define the future of industrial tech. As a CAE Engineer at Tractian, you'll drive the innovation and development of our IIoT solutions. Collaborating across teams, you'll apply your expertise in mechanics and design to create high-performance products that redefine industrial asset management. From concept to execution, your role will shape Tractian's industry-leading technology, ensuring top-tier quality and functionality in every solution we deliver. Responsibilities  Set up and run FEM analyses: linear/nonlinear static, modal transient, random, frequency response, explicit, durability. Analyze vibrational behavior, derive FRFs, and interpret mode shapes to optimize performance. Apply DOE, response surfaces, optimization, and uncertainty analyses to explore design space and quantify risk. Plan and perform tests for model correlation and validation. Partner with test teams on accelerated life testing, translating field data into test requirements and simulation inputs. Script pre/post-processing (Python, MATLAB) to scale studies and improve modeling quality. Document standards, templates, and best practices; propose new methods to capture physics and speed up iteration. Work closely with product development, manufacturing, supplier quality, and production teams, guiding decisions with technical data. Deliver clear reports and presentations explaining assumptions, modeling choices, limitations, and design implications.  Requirements  Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Mechatronics, or related engineering field. Strong understanding of FEM fundamentals, with hands-on experience. Ability to explain model behavior and link results to underlying physics. Experience in test-based model calibration/validation and correlating simulation with experimental data. Knowledge of fatigue analysis and durability assessment. Proficiency in Python and/or MATLAB for data processing, automation, and custom tool development. Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate in a multidisciplinary environment. Proactive, self-directed learner who goes beyond the brief to resolve issues. Advanced English level. Live in or have availability to move to São Paulo.  Bonus points  Expertise in vibration and structural dynamics. Experience in optimization, robust/stochastic design, and uncertainty quantification. Hands-on experience with FEA pre-processing tools and solvers (e.g., Abaqus, Ansys, OptiStruct, Nastran, Radioss, HyperMesh/ANSA). title: BRA - Project Manager
description:
Confira a vaga para BRA - Project Manager em são paulo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Commitment: Full-time (Approx. 40 hours/week)  Company Overview:  Tidal is a Direct Placement Agency that helps job seekers find job opportunities for real growth. We work with stable, responsible businesses experienced in remote hires and are excited to welcome international team members. Tidal is owned and operated by consumer brand owners and operators. We have offshore team-building experience and aim to help businesses leverage global talent. About This Role:  We are seeking a performance-driven Project Manager  to oversee and execute multiple client projects. This role requires strong project execution, risk management, and client relationship-building to drive measurable results . You will be responsible for ensuring project success by meeting key performance indicators (KPIs) such as on-time delivery, client satisfaction, and process efficiency . Key Performance Responsibilities:  Project Planning & Execution  Lead at least five concurrent projects , ensuring 95%+ on-time completion within budget  while maintaining quality standards. Cross-Functional Coordination  Manage collaboration with internal teams (Data Analysts, Engineers, Sales) to ensure seamless execution and zero workflow bottlenecks . Client Relationship Management  Act as the primary contact for clients , ensuring at least 90%+ client satisfaction  through proactive communication and issue resolution. Stakeholder Communication  Conduct weekly project status meetings  with clients, providing clear updates and reducing escalations by 25% . Risk & Change Management  Identify risks early and implement mitigation strategies, ensuring zero critical project failures  and 100% adherence to scope changes. Process Optimization  Identify inefficiencies and implement improvements to reduce project turnaround times by at least 15% . Performance Monitoring & Reporting  Track project performance metrics, maintain 100% accurate documentation  and generate actionable insights for continuous improvement. Budget & Resource Management  Optimize resource allocation to maximize efficiency and reduce costs by at least 10%  per project. Client Success & Retention  Develop strategies to improve customer retention, contributing to a minimum of 90% repeat business  from existing clients. Post-Project Evaluation  Conduct project reviews to capture lessons learned and implement best practices, improving future project success rates by at least 20% . Software/Platforms/Tools:  Project Management:  Asana, Jira, Trello Qualifications:  At least 3-5 years of freelancing experience, ideally in project management within a B2B startup or marketing agency. Strong ability to manage multiple high-priority projects while maintaining key performance targets . Expertise in Agile methodologies and project management best practices. Exceptional organizational and time-management skills, with a track record of delivering measurable improvements . Strong verbal and written English communication skills for client and team interactions. Experience in risk management, stakeholder coordination, and customer success strategies. Proficiency in project management tools like Asana, Jira, or Trello. PMP certification or equivalent project management qualification is a plus. Proven ability to analyze project performance and implement improvements to drive efficiency.  #J-18808-Ljbffr

Acreditamos na tecnologia que conecta gente boa no que faz e que vive a diversidade para criar e compartilhar até os caminhos que a gente (ainda!) nem sabe quais são. Trabalhamos para gerar valor não só para os nossos usuários, mas, sobretudo, para as comunidades que servimos e toda a sociedade, tornando a vida das pessoas melhor com serviços que facilitem seu dia a dia - seja com serviços de mobilidade e entrega (99) ou pagamentos digitais (99Pay). Para facilitar a vida de milhões de pessoas todos os dias, desde 2018 fazemos parte da DiDi Global Inc., a maior plataforma de tecnologia e transporte por aplicativo do mundo. Somos pioneiros na criação de soluções inovadoras que começam no Brasil e que ganham escala para gerar impacto positivo em mais de 12 países em que a DiDi está presente. Essas inovações passam por sustentabilidade, segurança, inteligência artificial, mercado financeiro e um tanto mais. Seja para construir projetos do zero ou aprimorar nossas soluções, gostamos de desafios que nos fazem sentir frio na barriga, e é por isso que trabalhamos num ritmo acelerado, com respeito, colaboração e bom humor. Nessa jornada, também nos fortalecemos nas diferentes vivências e opiniões para crescermos juntos, errar rápido, aprender e ajustar o caminho para criar soluções que tragam ainda melhores resultados. #LI-Hybrid Team Overview A principal função da nossa equipe de vendas é desenvolver e expandir nosso portfólio de contas, garantindo que eles tenham um bom desempenho na plataforma 99. Através de um excelente atendimento ao cliente e de uma abordagem consultiva, o executivo de vendas deve estabelecer e manter relacionamentos comerciais bem-sucedidos e de longo prazo. Role Responsibilities O principal ponto de contato para nossos parceiros, garantindo uma comunicação próxima e contínua para gerar insights estratégicos, atender às suas necessidades e desenvolver planos de ação para crescimento e uma experiência aprimorada do usuário. Analisando dados e desenvolvendo uma compreensão profunda da dinâmica do mercado e do comportamento dos parceiros para projetar, planejar e implementar estratégias comerciais destinadas a aumentar as vendas. Construindo e promovendo relacionamentos de longo prazo baseados na confiança, com uma mentalidade ganha-ganha para garantir parcerias sustentáveis e mutuamente benéficas.  Role Qualifications Graduação em Administração de Empresas, Marketing, Relações Internacionais, ou áreas relacionadas. 2+ anos de experiência em gestão de contas e vendas consultivas (a senioridade será avaliada ao longo do processo seletivo). Capacidade e flexibilidade para se adaptar e aprender enquanto trabalha em um ambiente de startup em ritmo acelerado, com mudanças constantes e metas desafiadoras. Habilidades interpessoais: Habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita, com capacidade de persuadir e manter relações de trabalho construtivas, assertivas, colaborativas e cooperativas com clientes internos e externos em organizações multinacionais. Habilidades analíticas: Capacidade de diagnosticar, compreender tendências de mercado e implementar planos de ação. Senso de urgência e motivação para atingir objetivos enquanto analisa possíveis cenários. Experiência em atingir e superar metas de vendas. Conhecimento intermediário de Excel é um diferencial.  EEO Statement Geramos Valor para os Usuários - Existimos para fazer o melhor para os nossos usuários e inovamos para estarmos sempre na frente. Buscamos o equilíbrio entre experiência, eficiência e crescimento, tendo a segurança sempre em primeiro lugar. Somos Guiados por Dados - Acreditamos na tomada de decisão guiada por dados. Através dos números, navegamos em nosso negócio de forma estratégica. Somos Donos e Focados nos Resultados - Vamos além dos interesses pessoais para focar no que é melhor para a DiDi. Sempre cumprimos o que prometemos e buscamos a excelência na execução, estabelecendo uma barra alta e dando o nosso máximo em tudo que fazemos. Sempre Construímos Juntos - Juntos somos mais fortes. Temos a mente aberta e sempre remamos com respeito, empatia e confiança uns nos outros. Ouvimos a opinião de todos antes de tomar uma decisão e, quando decidimos algo, cumprimos o combinado juntos, mesmo se discordarmos. Somos Íntegros - Integridade é a nossa base e a linha que nunca ultrapassamos. Comunicamos com honestidade, transparência e ouvimos a voz de todos para sempre fazer o que é certo. Desenvolvemos uns aos Outros - Nosso crescimento vem da constante aventura de estarmos fora da nossa zona de conforto. Aceitamos desafios, nos superamos e trabalhamos em busca da excelência em tudo que fazemos. Desde o primeiro dia, nos desenvolvemos e ajudamos as pessoas ao nosso redor a crescerem também, elevando a nossa barra. Trabalhamos com Paixão & Diversão - Somos completamente apaixonados pelo que fazemos. Mantemos um espírito leve e otimista, contagiando o nosso ambiente com energia positiva. Somos resilientes, não temos medo de enfrentar desafios e sempre celebramos nosso sucesso. Vivemos a Diversidade - Para nós, o coração da diversidade é a inclusão, a igualdade e o respeito. Acreditamos que a diversidade promove um ambiente mais criativo e cheio de energia, por isso, celebramos as diferenças e aqui todos podem ser quem são.  Diversidade e Inclusão  Diversidade não é uma visão de futuro ou desejo de algo que queremos um dia, é um valor inegociável de quem somos hoje. Vivemos a inclusão, a pluralidade e o respeito e, para isso, contamos com a governança do Comitê de Diversidade que atua junto com o RH, a nossa liderança e os grupos de identidade - 99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Cores, 99Mulheres e 99Famílias. Essa é a nossa jornada já escrita que ainda tem muito caminho para percorrer. title: Junior Product Owner - Brazil
description:
Empresa está contratando Junior Product Owner - Brazil em são paulo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About North Star Network  North Star Network (NSN) is a global sports and betting media group that builds and operates leading digital brands connecting sports fans and bettors across 30+ countries.  Our mission is to turn passion for sports and gaming into trusted information, data-driven insights, and responsible entertainment.  We’re a multicultural, fully remote company uniting over 50 in-house and 200+ external experts from more than 20 nationalities across Europe, Africa, and the Americas.  About the Role  At North Star Network, we are looking for a Junior Product Owner for our Brazilian Business Unit to support our Product team in delivering high-quality, business-driven digital products.  This role is ideal for someone organized, curious, and eager to grow in Product Management, with a strong interest in digital products, user experience, and data-informed decision-making.  You will work closely with Product Owners, Product Managers, Tech, UX, QA, and business stakeholders to help translate business and user needs into clear, actionable product requirements, ensuring smooth delivery and continuous improvement across our platforms.  Key Responsibilities  1. Backlog Management & Specification   Assist in maintaining a structured and organized product backlog.  Draft initial user stories and acceptance criteria based on guidance and documented user or business needs.  Support refinement sessions with Tech, UX, and stakeholders to clarify requirements.  Help assess and communicate feature priorities according to business objectives and constraints.    2. Sprint Preparation & Delivery Support   Support backlog grooming sessions by preparing tickets and ensuring required details are available.  Clarify straightforward questions from the development team, escalating complex topics to the Product Owner or Product Manager.  Help validate completed stories by checking alignment with acceptance criteria.  Flag potential requirement gaps, risks, or dependencies to the Product Owner or Product Manager early.    3. Product Quality & Feedback Loop   Contribute to ensuring user stories lead to high-quality product increments.  Collaborate with QA by supporting test case preparation and helping review defects.  Collect basic user feedback, operational insights, or data points to support iteration.  Uphold consistency in product behavior and user experience by reporting inconsistencies.    4. Stakeholder Communication   Assist in maintaining communication between stakeholders and the development team.  Help prepare status updates, release notes, or documentation for internal stakeholders.  Communicate small updates or clarifications, while escalating major decisions to the Product Owner or Product Manager.  Ensure continuous alignment with the Product Owner and Product Manager on prioritization and scope.    What We’re Looking For   1–3 years of experience in a Product, Project, Business Analyst, or Tech-related role (or relevant internships).  Strong organizational and communication skills.  Ability to structure information clearly and write concise product documentation.  Basic understanding of Agile / Scrum methodologies and product development cycles.  Analytical mindset with an interest in data, user behavior, and business impact.  Comfortable working with cross‑functional, fully remote teams.  Fluency in English (written and spoken); French or other languages are a plus.  Interest in digital media, sports, or iGaming is a strong advantage.    What We Offer   A hands‑on Product role with strong learning and growth opportunities.  Exposure to international, high‑traffic digital products in sports and betting media.  100% remote work environment with flexible collaboration across time zones.  A multicultural, fast‑growing team passionate about sports, data, and digital innovation.  A culture of autonomy, ownership, and continuous improvement.  Competitive salary.    Ready to Join Us?  If you’re eager to grow in Product Management, enjoy working at the intersection of business, tech, and user experience, and want to contribute to impactful digital products we’d love to hear from you.  Apply now and help shape the next generation of NSN’s products.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

Buscamos pessoas que entendem que a comunicação assertiva e a negociação empática  são a chave para a sustentabilidade do negócio e para a recuperação dos planos  de nossos clientes. Se você tem paixão por encontrar soluções e é movido(a) por resultados, queremos te conhecer!  Venha ser o agente que transforma desafios financeiros em recomeços! Você será a voz da solução, utilizando o telefone como principal ferramenta para atuar com inteligência, cordialidade e assertividade para encontrar a melhor saída para clientes com parcelas em aberto.  Esta função exige uma mente ágil para propor soluções viáveis de renegociação e um coração empático para guiar o cliente de volta ao caminho de seus sonhos.  Você fará parte de um time que investe em desenvolvimento contínuo para garantir a alta performance em comunicação e negociação.  Estamos construindo um banco de talentos com os futuros especialistas em resolução da HS Consórcios!   Seus Principais Desafios Serão:    Ser o solucionador proativo:  Realizar ligações ativas com foco em cobrança e, principalmente, em negociação e resolução, ajudando os clientes a manterem seus planos ativos;  Arquitetar soluções viáveis:  Analisar o cenário de cada cliente para propor as melhores alternativas de renegociação, sempre respeitando as políticas da empresa e a capacidade do cliente;  Promover o atendimento consultivo:  Conduzir o atendimento de forma cordial e assertiva, utilizando a escuta ativa para entender a fundo a situação e guiar o cliente através do script de forma natural e empática, do início ao fechamento do acordo;  Foco em excelência e evolução:  Participar ativamente de treinamentos e feedbacks individuais para garantir a melhoria contínua da sua performance e o atingimento dos indicadores;  Colaboração e alinhamento:  Estar presente em reuniões de alinhamento, capacitação e em ações motivacionais, mantendo-se sempre atualizado(a) sobre as melhores práticas do setor.    Requirements and skills   Ensino Médio completo.  Conhecimento básico em Pacote Office (principalmente Excel), demonstrando organização para gerenciar informações.  Capacidade natural de se comunicar de forma clara, cordial e focada em resultados (negociação).  Perfil motivado por desafios e determinado a superar objetivos.  Experiência prévia em áreas de cobrança, negociação, telemarketing ativo ou call center será considerado um diferencial.    Additional information  Na HS Consórcios , celebramos a vida e a concretização de planos, e isso começa por construir uma cultura onde você é valorizado(a) por quem você é.  Abraçamos a diversidade em seu sentido mais amplo, garantindo um ambiente de respeito e inclusão, acolhendo pessoas de diferentes origens, gêneros, etnias, idades, experiências e formas de pensar. Canonical es una empresa de software global, editora de Ubuntu y soluciones empresariales de código abierto para la nube, desarrolladores, IoT e IA. Ubuntu es la distribución de Linux de más rápido crecimiento y se posiciona como el sistema operativo número uno en la nube. En colaboración con Google, Amazon, IBM y Microsoft, Canonical ayuda a las empresas a ser más ágiles, productivas y a adoptar nuevas tecnologías rápidamente. Ejemplos de éxito incluyen proyectos en IA, Blockchain, IoT, robótica avanzada y vehículos autónomos, donde Ubuntu es la plataforma preferida para el desarrollo. El papel de un representante de desarrollo de ventas en Canonical Canonical es rentable y está en crecimiento. Consideramos que nuestro equipo de desarrollo de ventas es uno de los mejores en el mercado tecnológico, seleccionando candidatos excepcionales y ambiciosos. Disfrutarás este rol si eres organizado, persistente, carismático y trabajador, con interés en la tecnología y sus aplicaciones comerciales. Colaborarás con equipos regionales de ventas y marketing, con el objetivo principal de identificar proyectos de clientes que se ajusten a nuestros productos y promover la marca Canonical en diversas industrias y regiones. Cómo será tu día Atender consultas entrantes de clientes vía email, teléfono y chat. Ejecutar campañas de ventas y marketing salientes. Viajar a eventos y conferencias globales, presentar en stands y promover oportunidades de negocio en persona. Colaborar con múltiples equipos y altos ejecutivos para impulsar resultados. Trabajar con marketing en campañas específicas. Investigar potenciales clientes. Generar un pipeline de ventas de varios millones. Identificar tendencias y oportunidades de mercado. Definir procesos y políticas del equipo. Servir como enlace con nuevos y actuales clientes, organizando reuniones y explorando cuentas para nuevas oportunidades. Crear, mantener y fomentar relaciones con clientes potenciales a nivel global.  Lo que buscamos en ti Excelentes resultados académicos en escuela y universidad. Pasión por los negocios y la tecnología. Compromiso con el aprendizaje y la mejora continua: curioso, flexible y analítico. Capacidad para resolver problemas creativamente y colaborar en equipo. Habilidades de comunicación verbal y escrita. Orientación a resultados y espíritu de superación. Persistencia y perseverancia.  Qué te ofrecemos El salario base dependerá de factores como ubicación, experiencia, conocimientos y habilidades. Además, ofrecemos beneficios adicionales, incluyendo bonificaciones anuales e incentivos por ventas o uso. Nuestra política de compensación busca garantizar justicia y equidad a nivel global. Entre los beneficios adicionales se incluyen: Presupuesto anual de USD 2000 para desarrollo personal y aprendizaje. Revisión salarial anual. Programas de reconocimiento y recompensas. Vacaciones anuales. Licencia parental. Programa de asistencia al empleado. Oportunidades de viaje para conocer colegas en "sprints". Priority Pass y mejoras en viajes para eventos corporativos de larga distancia.  Canonical promueve igualdad de oportunidades. Valoramos la diversidad y fomentamos un ambiente inclusivo donde todos sean considerados sin discriminación, independientemente de su identidad o antecedentes.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Field Enablement Manager (LATAM)
description:
Nova oportunidade para Field Enablement Manager (LATAM) em são paulo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

The Team  Our GTM Enablement team plays a critical role in helping Datadog’s Sales and Customer Success teams succeed by equipping them with the right skills, knowledge, and tools at the right time. We partner closely with teams across Sales, Customer Success, Product Marketing, Curriculum, and Operations to ensure enablement programs translate into real performance in the field.  As Datadog continues to invest in LATAM, this role represents a foundational hire—helping establish how enablement shows up locally while staying tightly connected to our global enablement ecosystem.  The Opportunity  Datadog is growing quickly across Latin America, and we’re looking for our first Field Enablement Manager based in LATAM  to support this momentum. This role will be responsible for delivering ongoing ramp and everboarding enablement  for our Sales and Customer Success teams across LATAM—particularly for sellers and CSMs based in Brazil and Mexico .  In addition, you’ll support Spanish- and Portuguese-speaking sellers based in North America  (e.g., Boston, Denver, Atlanta) who sell into LATAM accounts. You’ll serve as a trusted partner to the field, ensuring global enablement programs land effectively in the local context—across language, culture, sales motion, and market dynamics.  This role is ideal for someone who thrives as an independent operator, builds strong relationships in the field, and enjoys adapting enablement to meet regional needs while staying aligned with global standards. This role will report into the our global Field Enablement team based in New York City and continue partnering with Field Enablement Managers globally across all regions and segments.  What You’ll Do   Deliver live and virtual enablement sessions focused on ongoing ramp and everboarding  for Sales and Customer Success teams across LATAM.  Partner closely with Sales and CS leaders in Brazil and Mexico  to understand performance needs and provide targeted enablement support.  Support Spanish- and Portuguese-speaking sellers based in North America who sell to LATAM customers.  Adapt and localize globally developed enablement programs to ensure relevance across language, culture, market context, and regional sales motions .  Design and facilitate reinforcement activities (e.g., role plays, deal clinics, skill practice sessions) that help sellers apply core concepts in real customer scenarios.  Collaborate closely with the Curriculum team  to share field insights, provide feedback on program effectiveness, and support continuous improvement of global content.  Track participation, collect feedback, and use qualitative and quantitative insights to assess enablement impact and identify opportunities for improvement.  Build trusted relationships with Sales, Customer Success, and cross‑functional partners to diagnose challenges and recommend appropriate enablement interventions.  Act as a regional connector—surfacing LATAM‑specific insights back to global enablement teams to help shape future programs.    Who You Are   3–5 years of experience in sales enablement, field enablement, training, or a related GTM role.  Experience supporting Sales and/or Customer Success teams in a SaaS or technology environment; regional or international experience is a strong plus.  Fluent in Spanish, Portuguese, and English  (required).  Strong facilitator with experience delivering engaging live and virtual training sessions.  Solid business acumen and comfort working with performance data, field feedback, and qualitative insights to inform enablement decisions.  Highly collaborative and relationship-oriented—you build trust quickly with sellers, managers, and cross‑functional partners.  Familiarity with sales methodologies such as MEDDICC or Command of the Message.  Foundational understanding of Datadog’s core product pillars (Infrastructure, APM, Logs) and the ability to connect product capabilities to customer value.  Organized, adaptable, and comfortable operating independently in a fast-growing region.  Scrappy and pragmatic—you enjoy building from the ground up and iterating as you go.  Willing and able to travel approximately 30%  across Latin America and North America.    Why This Role Matters  As Datadog’s first Field Enablement hire in LATAM, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping how enablement supports our sellers and Customer Success teams in the region. You’ll help ensure our global programs translate into local impact—accelerating ramp, improving confidence, and enabling teams to succeed with customers across a rapidly growing market.  Datadog (NASDAQ: DDOG) is a global SaaS business, delivering a rare combination of growth and profitability. We are on a mission to break down silos and solve complexity in the cloud age by enabling digital transformation, cloud migration, and infrastructure monitoring of our customers’ entire technology stacks. Built by engineers, for engineers, Datadog is used by organizations of all sizes across a wide range of industries. Together, we champion professional development, diversity of thought, innovation, and work excellence to empower continuous growth. Join the pack and become part of a collaborative, pragmatic, and thoughtful people‑first community where we solve tough problems, take smart risks, and celebrate one another. Learn more about #DatadogLife on Instagram , LinkedIn, and Datadog Learning Center.  Equal Opportunity at Datadog  Datadog is proud to offer equal employment opportunity to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and other characteristics protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. Here are our Candidate Legal Notices for your reference. This form is for accommodation requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications.   #J-18808-Ljbffr
